name: MTDC Harihareshwar Beach Resort Dining
why_it_matters: In-house restaurant at the MTDC Harihareshwar Beach Resort — the most reliable sit-down dining in the village. Konkani thali at lunch + dinner; multi-cuisine menu for non-Konkani travellers. AC + non-AC sections. The MTDC compound is a 5-min walk to the Pradakshina Marg circumambulation rocks behind Kalbhairav temple.
insider_tip: Resort guests get priority at lunch 1-2:30pm; walk-ins should book +91-2147-264360 by 11:30am. Beach-view terrace tables open from 4pm.

name: Hotel Vaibhav
why_it_matters: Family-run Konkani seafood + veg-thali stop on Harihareshwar beach road, 200m from the temple. Surmai (king mackerel) thali (rice + sol kadhi + papad + curry) is the lunch order. Veg thali available with bhakri + bharli vangi. Open 8am-10pm with lunch 12-3pm.
insider_tip: Surmai thali sells out by 1:30pm in peak season (Oct-May) — arrive by 12:30. Modak available only during Ganesh Chaturthi window. Cash + UPI; no cards.

name: MTDC Karli Resort Dining
why_it_matters: The MTDC Karli Resort sits on the Bagmandala side of the Savitri estuary, 7km from Harihareshwar — its restaurant catches the ferry-bound traffic at breakfast (misal pav before the 9am Bankot ferry) and lunch (Konkani thali after the 1pm ferry return). Estuary-facing terrace. Open 7am-10:30pm.
insider_tip: Breakfast 7:30-9am beats the ferry queue; lunch 1-2:30pm is post-ferry. Filter coffee here is the Konkani-style decoction, not the Udupi pour. Book +91-2147-265052.

name: Naivedyam Bhojanalaya
why_it_matters: Pure-veg brahmin-style thali kitchen 100m from the Harihareshwar Kalbhairav temple — naivedyam is the offering after darshan, and the kitchen frames itself as the post-puja meal. Bhakri (jowar flatbread) + pithla (gram-flour curry) + bharli vangi on a steel thali. Closed during Pradakshina afternoon temple closure 1-3pm.
insider_tip: Lunch service 11am-1pm gets the freshest preparations — second batch at 3:30pm is reheated. Sol kadhi free with thali. Cash + UPI only.
